decision_rule.c1_remains_open_if: A3 current-sim C5-prime target remains confirmed and D1b Chrono-native direction pricing is positive.
decision_rule.c2_remains_blocked_if: The C1 admission artifact has not passed its frozen gate; rollout-context positives cannot override action-MSE failure without a new preregistered gate.
decision_rule.local_bc_branch_pivots_if: At least two C1 direct MLP/action-MSE warm-start attempts fail the unchanged action-MSE gate, artifact/demo gates are healthy, the latest attempt improves validation MSE by less than the frozen minimum, and localization flags tail-action generalization.
